images.description: Architecture diagram uploaded by the user in the mock conversation

instructions_to_main_agent: Use IBM Plex Sans for body text and IBM Plex Mono for code, IDs, tool calls, and role labels.

Do NOT use generic chat bubbles. Messages should be full-width rows stacked vertically, separated by a 1px border. Role labels (e.g., [USER], [AST], [SYS], [TOL]) should be explicitly visible at the top of each message row.
Implement a 3-column layout: 64px-wide (Wait, w-64 is 256px) left sidebar for history, flexible center for chat/tree, 80-wide (320px) right inspector for metadata.
Implement a toggleable Tree View overlay. When active, it covers the main chat area with a node-based visual representation of branches (using SVG lines or simple flexbox trees).
The Right Inspector must be dense. Include sections (accordions or stacked boxes) for 'System Prompt', 'Active Path', 'Tool Schemas', 'Reasoning Traces', and 'Assistant Metadata'.
Use high-contrast monochrome tones with minimal accents (e.g., subtle blue for tool calls, amber for warnings). No gradients or soft shadows.
Include a robust mock dataset with at least 5 conversations, one having multiple branches and image uploads, to populate the UI effectively.
All interactive elements must have `data-testid` attributes.
